label: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon exposure in battlefield and beyond: Implications for environmental- and human health.
summary: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are combustion pollutants that are released into the environment through natural events and anthropogenic activities. Exposures to PAHs occur in military personnel during garrison (non-combat) and active deployment (combat) environments. Exposures that occur at low levels during deployment could lead to health issues, post-deployment.
